theme.title: Quiet Session
theme.summary: Materials (+0.33%) and Health Care (+0.11%) led the market today, while Technology (-0.52%) and Energy (-0.24%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.23%, defensives +0.02%, and value/cyclicals -0.01% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.18%, Dow -0.85%, Nasdaq -0.06% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.58%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 0.13% to 15.12, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 2.42% to $4,427.60, crude oil was little changed at $76.83, and bitcoin gained 1.53% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
